wilcoxon.all_zero: statistic n*(n+1)/4; p=1; no normal approximation needed

descriptive.aggregate: equal-fold mean and sample SD; tasks separate
descriptive.positive_comparison: S4/S5/S6/S8 by source SHA, file and node identity

limitations: CV folds share training data; not independent seeds
outer results guide this exploratory continuation decision, not independent confirmation
same common initial tensors; modality-dropout streams depend on S6 spec and differ from S4
teacher inference is an empirical reference, not a mathematical upper bound
S5/S8 use identical all initial tensors and RNG identities; only student rows are permuted
Student outer teacher cosine is diagnostic, never a fit or stopping input

conditional_test.correction: Holm jointly with S5-S4 only if S8 executed
conditional_test.selection_limitation: S8 is outcome-gated; Holm does not remove exploratory selection

statistics.teacher_gap: Report S5-S6 and S5-S4 in pp; retention ratio only if S6-S4 > 0, otherwise not interpretable

final_server_intent: Separate sufficiently provisioned server batch; RTX3050 limits local work only

execution_policy.OOM: stop, retain, no resizing or CPU fallback
